SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
& S. M. R. L. G. S. M.
S. D. D. 3353.
18. 3. 32.

March 18 32

Sir,

With reference to your letter No.739 of
March 8, 1932, I have the honour to state that
there is nothing in the Police records against
Marie Jessie Campbell and Jean Anita Murray who
have applied to your Consulate-General for a visa
to visit Netherlands India.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Officer i/c Special Branch.

Consul-General for the Netherlands,
Shanghai.

先生：

关于贵馆1932年3月8日第739号来函，谨此奉告，在警务处档案中，申请向贵总领事馆领取前往荷属东印度签证的玛丽·杰西·坎贝尔（Marie Jessie Campbell）和琼·安妮塔·默里（Jean Anita Murray）二人并无不良记录。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

特务科主管警官。

荷兰驻上海总领事，
上海。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 739.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. BRANCH
No. S. B. D. 218
9 3 32

SHANGHAI, 8th March 1932.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that the following
persons have applied to this Consulate for a visa to
Netherlands India :

No. received in
room 325.
9/3 32 N.P.

1° Marie Jessie Campbell, born at Hankow on July 22nd
1902, holder of a French "protégée" passport No. 1399,
issued at Shanghai on August 1st 1930. Applicant
has been working with Caldbeck McGregor & Co. and
her last private address was 11 YuenMingYuen Road.
She intends to proceed to Singapore via Java.

No received in
room 325.
9/3. 32 N.P.

2° Jean Anita Murray, born at Norwalk, Wisconsin, U.S.A.
on April 1st 1905, holder of an American passport
No. 629, issued at Honolulu on June 27th 1930. Her
private address is 51 Nanyang Road and her office
address c/o L. Everett & Co., 24 the Bund.

I should feel grateful to learn whether anything is known
to the Police against these persons, to whom meanwhile a
visé was granted, as there seemed to be reason to suppose
that they were bona fide tourists.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Vice-Consul
for Consul-General.

T. P. Givens, Esquire,
Officer in charge of Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,

S2.

刑事与特务科
S. B. D. 218号
1932年3月9日

上海，1932年3月8日。

先生：

谨此通知，下列人员已向本领事馆申请前往荷属东印度的签证：

325室收讫。
1932年3月9日 N.P.

1° 玛丽·杰西·坎贝尔，1902年7月22日出生于汉口，持有1930年8月1日在上海签发的法国“受保护人”护照，号码1399。申请人曾在卡尔德贝克·麦格雷戈公司（Caldbeck McGregor & Co.）任职，其最后私人住址为圆明园路11号。她计划经爪哇前往新加坡。

325室收讫。
1932年3月9日 N.P.

2° 琼·安妮塔·默里，1905年4月1日出生于美国威斯康星州诺沃克（Norwalk），持有1930年6月27日在火奴鲁鲁签发的美国护照，号码629。其私人住址为南阳路51号，办公地址为外滩24号L. Everett & Co.转交。

如蒙告知警方是否掌握上述人员的任何不良记录，不胜感激。鉴于有理由推测她们是 bona fide（真诚/真实）的游客，目前已向她们签发了签证。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

副总领事
代总领事。

T. P. 吉文斯（Givens）先生，
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科主管警官，

S2.
